content: What is the formula for "data risk"? It's mentioned in the query but not defined in the external knowledge. Is it the same as CDVR (Cross-Border Data Volume Risk), or a different calculation?

args.sql:
SELECT 
    df.recordregistry AS flow_id,
    ROUND(CAST((rm.riskassess / rm.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN df.orignation != df.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS numeric), 4) AS cross_border_risk_factor,
    ROUND(CAST((rm.riskassess / rm.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN df.orignation != df.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * dp.volgb AS numeric), 4) AS data_risk,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (rm.riskassess / rm.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN df.orignation != df.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * dp.volgb DESC) AS rank
FROM dataflow df
JOIN dataprofile dp ON df.recordregistry = dp.recordregistry
JOIN riskmanagement rm ON df.recordregistry = rm.flowlink
WHERE (rm.riskassess / rm.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN df.orignation != df.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * dp.volgb > 1000
ORDER BY data_risk DESC
LIMIT 5;
